narr: A thunderstorm produced heavy rain and flash flooding in the Calwood burn area. Law enforcement reported a 3 to 4 foot surge of debris and water flowing down Geer Canyon. |The debris flow impacted stretches of Geer Canyon Drive and the lower part of Geer Canyon.
ev: Heavy rain produced flash flooding in Geer Canyon in the Calwood burn area.
lsr: LAW ENFORCEMENT IS REPORTING A 3-4 FOOT SURGE OF DEBRIS AND WATER FLOWING DOWN GEER CANYON.
